clips.title: The story
paras: At Thunderbrew Distillery outside Kharanos, Tannok Frosthammer waits anxiously for supplies from Coldridge Valley. Trogg attacks have cut off the roads to Anvilmar.

Tannok Frosthammer watches deliveries and listens for news at Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Troggs have surged through Coldridge Pass, cutting off the usual route from Coldridge Valley and regular word from Anvilmar. Hands Springsprocket, a gnome tinkerer, carries supplies and news through the dangerous, snowy pass. Tannok shares the quiet worry of many Bronzebeards as subterranean troggs creep closer to their doorsteps.
